title: Cartesian geometric descent and effective groupoids in spaces
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$; small means $\mathcal U$-small and all categories under discussion fit in $\mathcal U'$. Use spaces and coherent diagrams of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a small simplicial space $X_\bullet$ write $|X_\bullet|=\operatorname{colim}_{\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}}X_n$. The map $X_0\to|X_\bullet|$ is surjective on $\pi_0$. Geometric realization commutes with finite products of simplicial spaces. If a natural transformation $Y_\bullet\to X_\bullet$ has a pullback naturality square for every arrow of $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, then $Y_n\to|Y_\bullet|$ over $X_n\to|X_\bullet|$ is a pullback square for each $n$. For a nonempty ordered subset $S\subseteq[n]$, write $G_S=G_{|S|-1}$ with restriction induced by increasing enumeration. A simplicial space $G_\bullet$ is called a groupoid object if, for every union $[n]=S\cup T$ with one common vertex, its restriction map $G_n\to G_S\times_{G_{S\cap T}}G_T$ is an equivalence. Every groupoid object in spaces is effective: its augmentation $G_0\to|G_\bullet|$ is surjective on $\pi_0$, and $G_n\simeq G_0\times_{|G_\bullet|}\cdots\times_{|G_\bullet|}G_0$ with $n+1$ factors, naturally with the simplicial operators. In particular $G_1\simeq G_0\times_{|G_\bullet|}G_0$. For a commutative square $Y\to Y\prime$ over $X\to X\prime$, let $q:Y\to X\times_{X\prime}Y\prime$ be its pullback comparison. If $T\to X$ is surjective on $\pi_0$ and $q$ is an equivalence on every homotopy fiber over every point of $T$, then $q$ is an equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem space_geometric_descent : (∀ X : index SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ ⟶ spaceCategory.{u}, ∃ F : index AugmentedIndex ⟶ spaceCategory.{u}, indexMap WithTerminal.incl ≫ F = X ∧ IsRealization F) ∧ (∀ F : index AugmentedIndex ⟶ spaceCategory.{u}, IsRealization F → SurjectiveOnComponents (arrow F (WithTerminal.homFrom (op ⦋0⦌)))) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (F : index (AugmentedIndex × WithInitial (Discrete (Fin r))) ⟶ spaceCategory.{u}), (∀ j : WithInitial (Discrete (Fin r)), IsRealization (indexMap (column j) ≫ F)) → (∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, IsLimitCone (indexMap (row (WithTerminal.of n)) ≫ F)) → IsLimitCone (indexMap (row WithTerminal.star) ≫ F)) ∧ (∀ F : index (AugmentedIndex × Fin 2) ⟶ spaceCategory.{u}, (∀ i : Fin 2, IsRealization (indexMap (column i) ≫ F)) → (∀ (j k : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ k), IsCartesian (indexMap (naturalityIndex (WithTerminal.incl.map f)) ≫ F)) → ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, IsCartesian (indexMap (naturalityIndex (WithTerminal.homFrom n)) ≫ F)) ∧ (∀ G : index AugmentedIndex ⟶ spaceCategory.{u}, IsRealization G → IsGroupoidObject (indexMap WithTerminal.incl ≫ G) → SurjectiveOnComponents (arrow G (WithTerminal.homFrom (op ⦋0⦌))) ∧ IsEffective G) ∧ (∀ (Y Y' X X' T : SSet.{u}) [KanComplex Y] [KanComplex Y'] [KanComplex X] [KanComplex X'] [KanComplex T] (top : Y ⟶ Y') (left : Y ⟶ X) (right : Y' ⟶ X') (bottom : X ⟶ X') (H : SSet.Homotopy (top ≫ right) (left ≫ bottom)) (q : Y ⟶ simplicialHomotopyPullback right bottom) (hq : IsSquareComparison top left right bottom H q) (cover : T ⟶ X), SurjectiveOnComponents cover → (∀ (t : T _⦋0⦌) (φ : homotopyFiber left (cover.app _ t) ⟶ homotopyFiber (pullback.snd _ _) (cover.app _ t)), IsInducedFiberMap (comparisonOverBaseHomotopy hq) (cover.app _ t) φ → IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence φ) → IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence q)
lean.note: Coherent simplicial spaces are maps from the lifted simplex nerve into the actual simplicial nerve of the inherited enriched category of small Kan complexes. Augmentations and all product and pullback cones retain their entire coherent diagrams. The groupoid condition uses all singleton-intersection covers, and effectiveness is the vertex-and-augmentation right Kan extension condition. The final clause characterizes every coordinate of the canonical homotopy-pullback comparison, including its specified commutation path. Added statement dependencies are already landed declarations of the space, fixed-boundary fiber and path-pullback notions; the algebroid dependency is used only for its inherited space conventions. Reviewer fix (2026-10-17): limits, colimits, realizations and cartesian squares now use the recorded def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones predicates IsLimiting/IsColimiting on coneCategory/coconeCategory; the cone or cocone induced by a diagram on a cone-shaped index is pinned by its apex `point` and its whole transformation `prism` (coneHomotopy, and coconeHomotopy of lem-coef-infinity-final-index-colimit), replacing the delivery's private fixed-boundary extension predicates.
